the exact master equation for a quantum mechanical model of two harmonic oscillations coupled to an environment is available and can be used to study decoherence of entanglement in the model.
the exact master equation for a system of two coupled harmonic oscillator interacting with a general bath is obtained, and the decoherence of the two oscillators is studied.

a master equation for a system of two coupled quantum harmonic oscillator in a common environment is available and can be easily derived from the known results for the single harmonic oscillator.
the master equation of a system of coupled harmonic oscillators can be obtained exactly from that of the uncoupled harmonic oscillator system in an environment.
